about: SS Retail runs the SS Mobile, The Mobile Space and Mobile Exchange Wala multi-brand chains selling mobile phones, accessories and other electronics. It had 503 stores in 5 states at March 2026, with 458 in Maharashtra, and says it is the largest mobile phone retail chain in West India and the 3rd largest in India among its peers. Most stores are franchisee-operated (COFO/FOFO models).
sector: Mobile phone and consumer electronics retail

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure for fit-outs of new stores in FY27 and FY28
Part funding of incremental working capital requirements

promoters.background: Founder Siddharth Gunvant Shah has over 24 years of experience in mobile phone retail; the four promoters sell part of their stake in the offer for sale.

concentration.note: Top 10 suppliers were 79.09% of purchases in FY26 (89.42% in FY25). Mobile phones are 86.18% of revenue and Maharashtra is 89.09% of revenue.

litigation_note: One criminal Legal Metrology complaint (2023) against the company, directors and a promoter over packaged accessories pricing, pending; no material civil litigation against the company. Contingent liabilities are 2.85 crore (1.27% of net worth) for disputed GST, plus bank guarantees of 8 crore.
strengths: Largest mobile phone retail chain in West India and 3rd largest in India by store count, with 503 stores in 215 cities at March 2026.
Revenue grew from 1,206.74 crore in FY24 to 2,351.03 crore in FY26, a 39.58% CAGR, and PAT rose from 26.65 crore to 59.28 crore.
Franchisee-led COFO and FOFO models (74.19% of revenue) keep the company's capital spending on stores low.
Return on average equity of 30.60% and post-tax ROCE of 22.54% in FY26 are the highest among listed peers.
Focus on tier II and tier III cities: 17.89% and 51.69% of stores respectively.
Sales per sq ft rose to 1,46,347 in FY26 from 1,15,341 in FY24, which the company says is the highest among peers.
Gross margin improved from 10.67% in FY24 to 12.18% in FY26 and operating EBITDA margin from 4.68% to 5.32%.
Plans 120 new stores each in FY27 and FY28; the store count was already 536 by July 2026.

risks.title: Heavy reliance on mobile phones
risks.detail: Mobile phones gave 86.18% of FY26 revenue (87.58% in FY25). A slowdown in phone demand would hit the whole business, and net margin is thin at 2.52%.

risks.title: Supplier concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 suppliers were 79.09% of FY26 purchases of traded goods (89.42% in FY25, 88.38% in FY24). Supply delays or lost brand arrangements could hurt sales.

risks.title: Geographic concentration in Maharashtra
risks.detail: 458 of 503 stores (91.05%) and 89.09% of FY26 revenue come from Maharashtra, so local economic or political changes affect results.

risks.title: Working capital intensive with high borrowings
risks.detail: Borrowings were 162.59 crore against net worth of 225.45 crore at March 2026, mostly short-term. 241.35 crore of the IPO proceeds is for working capital. Operating cash flow was negative 4.93 crore in FY24 and only 1.42 crore in FY25.

risks.title: Dependence on franchisee-led models
risks.detail: COFO and FOFO models gave 74.19% of FY26 revenue. Weak franchisee performance or store closures would slow growth; 27 stores closed in FY26.

risks.title: Rich valuation versus peers
risks.detail: The cap price implies a P/E of 46.54 on FY26 EPS of 9.11, against a peer average of 31.89. Of the 500 crore offer, 140 crore is an offer for sale by promoters and another holder, whose money does not go to the company.

risks.title: Past Companies Act non-compliances and a pending criminal case
risks.detail: Compounding and adjudication applications are pending with the RoC for past lapses. A 2023 Legal Metrology criminal complaint names the company, directors and a promoter.

risks.title: Related-party dealings
risks.detail: The company has many transactions with directors and their relatives (rent, loans, advances), including a 7.91 crore trade advance paid to a promoter HUF entity in FY26. Contingent liabilities are 2.85 crore and commitments 8.94 crore.

notes: FY26 is consolidated (includes Olineo acquired Jan 2026 with 34 stores, and Nexora); FY25 and FY24 are standalone, so growth is not like-for-like. Prospectus figures are in million and converted to crore. EBITDA is the company-defined operating EBITDA (excludes other income). Net worth is equity attributable to owners (FY26 total equity incl. NCI is 231.34 crore). Borrowings are current plus non-current borrowings (consistent with reported net debt); lease liabilities excluded. cash_and_bank includes other bank balances. debt_equity is gross borrowings over total equity (computed; the reported figure is net debt to equity 0.77/0.60/0.58). current_ratio is computed from current assets and liabilities. Operating cash flow was reconstructed from garbled text and cross-checked against the net change in cash. Employee reservation percent is of total offer shares; anchor/QIB/NII/retail percentages are of the net offer. Post-issue P/E not stated. Price band 403-424 with Rs 25 employee discount.
